Datasets are NOT stored in git (same approach as upstream csgobot / Priler).

Why: archives are too large even for Git LFS.
Farm PCs never need them — use EnsureWeights.bat for the ~50 MB .pt only.
See docs\PRODUCT_MODEL_LIFECYCLE.md

=== TRAIN machine bootstrap ===
One-click on Windows (repo root):
  BootstrapDataset.bat

Uses Python API (huggingface_hub.snapshot_download) — no huggingface-cli required.

Or manually from vendor\csgobot:
  venv\Scripts\python.exe yolov8\datasets\run_product_pipeline.py --workdir yolov8\datasets --hf-repo fvossel/csgo-player-detection --hf-local-dir hf_raw\fvossel_cs2 --hf-data-subdir data --out-root product_v1_bootstrap --classes c,ch,t,th --train-pct 80 --val-pct 10 --dedup-stem --manifest-out manifests\product_v1_bootstrap_manifest.json

Approved CS2 source (bootstrap):
  https://huggingface.co/datasets/fvossel/csgo-player-detection

Legacy CSGO-oriented source (reference only, not primary for CS2 CT fix):
  https://huggingface.co/datasets/Priler/csgobot

Own captures (later, for CT quality):
  Drop YOLO pairs into sources\our_cs2\{train,val,test}\{images,labels}
  See docs\CS2_DATASET_PIPELINE.md and docs\CS2_DATASET_STRATEGY.md

=== Farm fleet ===
  EnsureWeights.bat
